description: The pie chart visually represents the distribution of video content categories used in the study “Enhancing Multimodal LLM for Detailed and Accurate Video Captioning using Multi-Round Preference Optimization.” It is divided into 14 distinct segments, each labeled with a content category and its corresponding percentage. The largest segment, “People Blogs,” occupies 17.2% and is colored orange. The second largest is “Howto Style” at 9.7% (green), followed by “Entertainment” at 13.9% (purple). Other notable segments include “Education” (8.7%, red), “Film Animation” (4.6%, brown), “Sports” (7.7%, pink), “Gaming” (6.4%, gray), “Travel Events” (4.6%, yellow-green), “Comedy” (5.6%, cyan), “Science Technology” (6.4%, blue), “News Politics” (4.3%, light orange), “Pets Animals” (3.9%, light green), “Autos Vehicles” (4.8%, red-orange), and “Music” (2.3%, lavender). The chart uses a standard circular layout with percentage values displayed inside each slice, and no segments are exploded or emphasized visually. The categories appear to be arranged roughly in descending order of proportion, starting from the top-right and moving clockwise.
